description: This Java source file defines the EntityConditionBuilder class, which extends BuilderSupport and provides methods to construct complex entity conditions used in the Apache OFBiz framework. It involves creating and managing EntityCondition objects, supporting different condition types, and integrating with other OFBiz components.
